corrections.reason: The printed glyphs on Col 2 L02 are clearly 1st-order 'ጸ' and 'ረ' ('ነጸረ', perfect verb 'he beheld'), which pairs with the gerundive 'ክሂሎ' on the next line ('ነጸረ ክሂሎ ምስለ አምላኩ', standard Onomastica/Andemta etymology of Israel).
The second character on Col 2 L03 has the distinct top-right loop of 7th-order 'ሎ', completing the Ge'ez gerundive 'ክሂሎ' ('having prevailed / been able').
